articles.title: Why are AI’s biggest companies suddenly asking to slow down?
articles.snippet: AI’s biggest labs are suddenly calling for a slower pace of development. Is it because AI risks are catching up with the technology, or because the economics of the race are getting harder to justify?

articles.title: Fragmented regulations limit stablecoin adoption in international finance: WTO head
articles.snippet: Stablecoins may reduce trade finance friction, fragmented regulatory regimes limit their adoption to just 3% of global payments, according to the World Trade Organization.

articles.title: US Republicans send ‘final’ CLARITY Act offer to Democrats
articles.snippet: The 635-page revised proposal includes Trump-backed ethics provisions and comes just two days before a key procedural vote.

articles.title: AI Agents Just Slashed the Cost of a Quantum Attack on Bitcoin
articles.snippet: The ECDSA.Fail challenge cut a resource benchmark for one component of a potential quantum attack by 86%.
